signatures.description: Given a BGP route-reflector snapshot with competing paths per prefix (AS_PATH length, MED, local-pref, communities, origin validity stamps), compute the optimal egress selection per prefix while detecting poisoned announcements where an origin validity stamp contradicts the RPKI cache deltas embedded in the dump. Paths missing stamps must inherit conservative defaults that can flip the winner after a single attribute correction. Output the chosen path per prefix plus a minimal correction set of (prefix, peer) pairs whose repair changes the global egress map.
